description: chimera with persistent_handles on, so durable handles are advertised. Oplocks and leases are mandatory here because a durable grant is impossible without one of them -- MS-SMB2 3.3.5.9.6/.10 require a BATCH oplock or a HANDLE-caching lease, so a caching-off server could only ever generate refusals (probe D1). The share is NOT continuously available, so nothing here is persistent.
